name: Density Grid Sampler (JNeRF)
definition: A sampler that uses a 3D density grid (occupancy grid) to accelerate ray marching in NeRF by skipping empty space, using cascaded grids and non-uniform sampling.
summary: The Density Grid Sampler accelerates NeRF ray marching by using cascaded 3D density grids to skip empty space and guide adaptive, non-uniform sampling.
